Himmat matlab jo sahi, woh karna.
Dar ka saamna ho sakta; karna zaroori.
Himmat yeh jaanna hai ki kisse nahi darna hai.
Himmat ka matlab hai, rukna na maan kar aage badhte rehna.
Khamoshi ek bahut badi taakat ka zariya hai.
Courage right thing tab bhi karna jab nobody watches.
Quiet mind strong hote.
Grit aam logon ko mahan banata.
Bada hona aur asli banta—courage lagta.
Agar fast jaana hai, akelay jao. Agar door jaana hai, saath jao.
Saahas dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabu hai - dar ki anupasthiti nahi.
Chuppi sabse zor ki cheekh hai.
Grit ka matlab hai lambi muddat ke lakshya ke liye jazba aur lagan.
Khamoshi ki bhi awaaz hoti.
Himmat hai storm mein chalna.
Darr ek pratikriya hai, par himmat ek faisla hai.
Kabhi rukna nahi; kabhi settle nahi.
